title: Optimization for One, Feasibility for Most: Decoupling Optimization from Feasibility in Chance-Constrained Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chance-constrained stochastic programs (CCSPs) require solutions that satisfy uncertain constraints with high probability. Standard approaches either embed scenarios directly into optimization by considering sample average approximation (SAA)-based reformulations, growing prohibitively expensive and often failing to find feasible solutions; or employ conservative reformulations that guarantee feasibility but sacrifice objective quality by design. We propose ACCESS (Adaptive Chance-Constrained Exploration via Structured Sampling), a structured sampling framework that decouples optimization from feasibility evaluation. First, high-quality candidate solutions are generated by solving many inexpensive single-scenario subproblems, avoiding sampling directly in the constrained high-dimensional solution space. translated_title: 为一优化，为众可行：机会约束规划中优化与可行性的解耦
translated_abstract: 机会约束随机规划（CCSP）要求所求解以高概率满足不确定性约束。标准方法要么通过基于样本平均近似（SAA）的重构将场景直接嵌入优化过程，导致计算成本急剧增长且常常无法找到可行解；要么采用保守重构，虽能保证可行性，但从设计上牺牲了目标函数的质量。我们提出 ACCESS（Adaptive Chance-Constrained Exploration via Structured Sampling，基于结构化采样的自适应机会约束探索），这是一个将优化与可行性评估解耦的结构化采样框架。首先，通过求解大量代价低廉的单场景子问题来生成高质量候选解，从而避免直接在高维受约束解空间中进行采样。其次，通过在海量场景上进行大规模批量仿真来单独评估可行性，这一过程天然是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出ACCESS框架，将优化与可行性评估解耦——利用大量廉价的单场景子问题生成高质量候选解，再通过大规模批量仿真独立评估可行性，从而在机会约束随机规划中同时兼顾目标函数质量与高概率可行性。
en_tdlr: ACCESS decouples optimization from feasibility in chance-constrained stochastic programs by generating high-quality candidate solutions via many inexpensive single-scenario subproblems and then assessing feasibility through large-scale batched simulation, achieving both objective quality and high-probability feasibility.
